title: Implementation Framework for AI-Enabled HRM in UAE Limited Liability Companies
summary: A Dubai Government Human Resources Department use case proposes an AI decision-support toolkit for human resources staff; the sources name no software and report no result.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Dubai Government Human Resources Department contributed this use case. It describes a Doctor of Business Administration study with the University of Derby that draws on surveys of human resources professionals and interviews with senior human resources managers. The study aims to build an AI decision-making toolkit and a framework that measures how far AI tools cut human resources costs. The design of the toolkit uses human resources datasets for model training, selection, deployment and fine-tuning. Human resources staff submit queries and receive model responses. The contributors report that pilots with limited liability companies in the United Arab Emirates were in process in June 2025. Effects on costs, decision quality and hiring bias remain unmeasured.
purpose: Support HR personnel with AI-generated decisions to improve efficiency and reduce hiring bias.
system: Proposed AI decision-support toolkit for human resources
